data.name: Siegebound
data.detailed_description:
Siegebound: A Roguelike Tower Defense Strategy Game

Siegebound is a survival game about holding the line against constant sieges.
You build your defenses, deploy units, pick upgrades during the run, and try to survive as long as possible.

It mixes base building, tower defense, and roguelike progression into one loop where every run plays differently.

Features

🏰 Build Defenses
Place walls, towers, and support buildings to protect your objectives and control how enemies move.

⚔️ Deploy units and fight alongside them
Your units and buildings can be upgraded and combined in different ways.
You also control a Hero with active abilities, so you’re not just watching the battle.

🎲 Randomized upgrades as you level up
Each run gives you random upgrade choices that change how your units, buildings, and hero work.
Some runs might focus on strong walls, others on unit synergies or ability builds.

🌍 Different maps
Each map changes how you build your defenses and forces you to adapt.

No two runs are the same. Experiment with different builds and see how far you get :)

Playtest coming soon.
Wishlist if you want to try it early.

About the Developer

I'm Matzgo, a solo developer working on my dream game. Siegebound is a passion project inspired by my love for strategy games like Age of Empires, Stronghold, and roguelike games like Hades. My goal was to blend strategy game elements with roguelike systems, creating a game that rewards creative builds and adaptive playstyles.

Your feedback means everything!

Let’s build, defend, and survive

data.short_description: Siegebound is a roguelike tower defense strategy game where you build and defend a castle against relentless sieges. Construct walls, deploy units, and upgrade your defenses using a roguelike progression system that makes every run unique.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
